policies.title: Nine named African ordinary passports: Republic of the Congo visa exemption
policies.summary: API-Congo's live public-agency guidance expressly names these nine residual nationalities among the exhaustive exceptions to the Republic of the Congo's entry-visa requirement.
conditions: Applies to short visitors using ordinary national passports issued by Benin, Burkina Faso, Côte d’Ivoire, Guinea, Morocco, Mauritania, Niger, Senegal or Togo.
The official guidance does not state a waiver duration. Law No. 29-2017 defines a visitor stay as no more than three months, but the border authority controls the admitted stay.
Work, residence, diplomatic or special documents, health rules, public-order controls, carrier requirements and final admission remain outside this nationality-wide visitor baseline.

policies.title: Remaining ordinary passports: Republic of the Congo advance visitor visa
policies.summary: API-Congo's live public-agency guidance makes its nationality exception exhaustive and says every other foreign traveller to Congo-Brazzaville must hold a visa obtained through a Congolese embassy.
conditions: Applies to the exact 161 currently uncovered ordinary-passport nationalities that are outside API-Congo's exhaustive named exception list.

Apply through a Republic of the Congo embassy before travel. The guidance states that normal issuance does not exceed 15 days and describes a higher-cost same-day Express option; neither is a guarantee of approval.

Law No. 29-2017 requires an ordinary visitor outside a particular immigration agreement to present a valid passport with visa, return or onward transport, repatriation-deposit receipt, municipal accommodation certificate or hotel booking, and a valid international vaccination booklet.

No reviewed current official source establishes a nationality-wide eVisa or border-issued visa alternative for this cohort. Work, residence, special documents, carrier requirements and final admission remain outside scope.
